action.prompt:
This is the Nova AI chatbot project. Remind yourself of the key rules before starting:
- Frontend: React (Vite) in client/src/ — ES modules, plain CSS in index.css
- Backend: Node.js + Express in server/ — CommonJS, Groq API via groq-sdk
- Model: openai/gpt-oss-120b via GROQ_API_KEY in server/.env
- Never add: databases, auth, Docker, AWS, TypeScript, CSS frameworks
- Windows file writes: always use [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8
- PowerShell command separator: semicolon, never &&
- Start backend: cd server && node index.js (port 3001)
- Start frontend: cd client && npm run dev (port 5173)
